scope: S17 Source endpoint redirect and cross-company reassignment

implementation.endpoint_intent: an existing active Source stages an immutable redirect or correction change with old/new endpoint revisions and audit identity
implementation.endpoint_revision: the Source-owned sequence is monotonic; rejected or replaced candidate revisions are never reused
implementation.endpoint_activation: validation publication atomically appends activation bound to Listing Assignment, Source version, and evidence Artifacts
implementation.reassignment: preview/confirm creates a new candidate Source under the target Company and immutable supersedes or split_from lineage
implementation.history: old Source Company ownership, Jobs, Assignment, Checkpoint, observations, and artifacts are not rewritten or copied

contract_observation.staged_visibility: public source.endpoint.history shows a change without activation before validation
contract_observation.cutover: only evidence-gated validation publication switches active endpoint and appends activation
contract_observation.rejection: a rejected correction retains immutable intent and has no activation
contract_observation.checkpoint: endpoint cutover retains the existing checkpoint version and baseline occurrence lineage
contract_observation.supersedes: old Source is archived and a cancel-mode ScopeControlOperation is created atomically
contract_observation.split_from: old Source remains active and no cancellation operation is created
contract_observation.concurrency: two confirmations of the same preview produce exactly one new Source and one lineage
contract_observation.replay: confirmation returns the identical durable response after Server restart

verification.core_boundary: pass from a94d2b8d; no protocol/runtime/lib/platform/registry changes

acceptance.remaining_production_gate: none specific to S17; global S12/S18/S25/P9 gates remain
